dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Gitanmaax Band Kisgegas reserve situated on the Babine River. Land cover and features described on the map include soil types, spruce, and poplar. Also included is Ali-Ge-Sum-Dach Fishery, a mission, village, She-Din creek [Shedin Creek], mountains, and roads/trails from Hazelton and Kuldoe, and to Bear Lake. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1898. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by F. Carter-Cotton, Chief Commissioner of Lands and Works, 26 August 1899.]
